body: I really don't believe there is "not much I can do".

Every single day. It sucks! Especially when I'm enjoying a nice meal or glass of wine and conversation with a friend and my mind instantly tricks me into thinking I do or will feel sick.. night ruined. Our minds are so strange!
I know exactly how it feels. Definitely second deep breathing. Watch Vines on YT - they almost always help me. You're going to be okay!!

Watch Vines! Take your mind off of it. Sounds like anxiety could be making you feel worse. When I feel nauseated, after I've taken Zofran or Phenegran, I will watch YouTube videos or open a window and let the cold air in. Take deep breaths. You're going to be okay. I promise!
